verdict.rationale: Apify has a documented OpenAPI spec (apify-probe-2) and extensive API client docs with runnable code examples in JS/Python (apify-docs-15, apify-docs-16, apify-docs-17, apify-docs-19), but there's no evidence of an interactive API explorer/console where examples can be executed in-browser (e.g. Swagger UI/Postman-style try-it-now). missing for 10: interactive in-browser API console/playground, evidence of live 'run this call' UI tied to the OpenAPI reference.
